text:
deploy-bot: config deploy initiated by corey: CONFIG-ONLY -> soft-guardrail limitset v2 applied to routing_policy=conservative, batch_max_tokens=512, request_timeout_ms=14000. Canary plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 20m -> 100% final. change window 16:00-18:00 PT. @anya @mike :eyes:

anya: confirming change window, I'll be oncall 16:30-17:30 and can intervene if needed.

mike: what's the rollback criteria? propose: p99 latency increase >40ms OR token-error-rate >0.5% OR throttled_count spike >3x baseline. also watch: backend queue length and fallback routing events.

sophia: note that lowering batch_max_tokens from 1024 -> 512 may move some work to CPU, watch p95 and GPU queue times. I'll keep quick eyes on routing_fallbacks.

leo: this is config-only, no model pin needed. leaving model_version unset.

deploy-bot: canary 10% window complete (16:15). metrics snapshot: p95 +12ms, p99 +28ms, token_errors 0.12%, throttled_count +8%. No alerts triggered. Proceeding to 50%.

corey: ramping to 50% now. ping when stable.

mike: obs link: https://obs.internal/redwood/soft-guardrail/2164321000 — check throttled_count, reroute_fallbacks, and tokens_per_request.

sophia: seeing small steady increase in routing_fallbacks on route `low-latency` (+3 over baseline) and a couple of timeouts in that pool. I suggest reducing batch_max_tokens to 400 for latency-sensitive routes and re-evaluating before full roll.

corey: pause ramp. hold at 50% while sophia pushes a conservative tweak.

deploy-bot: applying patch: batch_max_tokens=400 to route filter `low-latency`. Re-checking canary subset (10m).

sophia: after patch (10m): p95 +8ms, p99 +18ms, routing_fallbacks normalized to baseline. token_errors unchanged. Looks good to me.

leo: thanks — with that, OK to continue to 100%.

deploy-bot: rolling to 100% now. final change log: soft-guardrail limitset v2 — conservative routing policy + reduced batch_max_tokens for latency-sensitive routes. Release note added to changelog: "Reduce batch size for low-latency routes; enforce conservative routing during GPU queue pressure."

mike: leaving this monitored for 2 hours. Rollback playbook ready if criteria hit. Thanks everyone.

Commands used during thread:
```
# quick canary status
curl -sS https://deploy.internal/api/canary/2164321000 | jq '.status, .metrics.p99, .metrics.token_errors'
```
